add_block.new_heading: What is on a mystery dining menu in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: A mystery dining menu in Dubai is built specifically for you and then kept secret until each course arrives. There is no fixed card to read; instead your private mystery dining chef in Dubai plans a progression — often five to eight small courses — that moves through textures, temperatures and cuisines in a deliberate arc. You share what you love, what you avoid and any ingredients that are off-limits, and the chef designs around that, leaving room to surprise you within your own tastes. Menus can lean modern European, Levantine, Asian or a playful mix; seasonal produce and a standout centrepiece usually anchor the meal. Wine or mocktail pairings can be built in course by course. What you do not get is the running order in advance — the menu is revealed one plate at a time, each dish introduced by the chef as it lands, so anticipation is part of every course.

add_block.new_heading: Is mystery dining legit, and what does a personal chef cost?
new_paragraphs: Mystery dining is a real and long-established practice: a diner books, eats and reports against a set brief, and the venue gets a structured account of the experience rather than a star rating. It is legitimate when the brief is agreed in advance and the reporting is honest, and it stops being legitimate the moment a report is written to a conclusion someone has already paid for.
